relationships.subject: 3-oxa-PD1n-3 DPA
relationships.evidence_quote: only 3-oxa-PD1n-3 DPA (6) was able to produce a transient reversal (at 1 hour time point) of STZ-induced neuropathic pain (mechanical allodynia) compared to vehicle group

relationships.subject: 3-oxa-PD1n-3 DPA
relationships.evidence_quote: using intrathecal injection (I.T.) of 300 pmol each of 2, 5 and 6 produced a significant reduction in the scratch number at one hour

relationships.subject: protectin D1
relationships.evidence_quote: Ji and co-workers reported that PD1 (2) is a potent agonist for GPR37

key_findings: Synthetic protectin D1 analog 3-oxa-PD1n-3 DPA relieved STZ diabetic neuropathic pain and CTCL chronic itch after intrathecal injection, active at the lowest dose (30 pmol).
